views.concern: Components involved in seat booking and their interactions
concern_details: What are the main system components involved in seat booking?
views.reason: Both concerns were answered 'not sure', so the choice comes from their wording. 'Main system components' and 'how do these components interact' ask which running parts take part in seat booking and how they connect through interfaces. The component viewpoint frames exactly this, so one view covers both concerns. The developer needs a balanced overview of the parts and their connections, not a step-by-step message trace of one scenario.

also.reason: A developer modifying code may mean the code-level components. A package diagram would show the modules or layers behind seat booking and their dependencies, which answers the same 'components and how they relate' concerns from the source-code side.
